chatgptPrompt:
Create a 9:16 (1080x1920) Short cover, focal point inside the centre safe area (clear of the bottom 25% and the right edge).
Subject: two real-looking fingertips side by side seen from the front, the left one smooth with fine fingerprint ridges, the right one deeply wrinkled like a prune, painted medium-brown skin, no face. Warm medium-brown skin tone (about RGB 180, 109, 75), the same tone throughout.
Composition: both fingertips fill the lower two thirds, rising from the bottom edge, ivory negative space above it for the text.
Lighting and treatment: warm key light from the upper left, soft depth of field, ivory ground (#F7EFE3), deep green #00685F as the only accent.
Mood: quiet curiosity.
Text: "Not just water." in a navy editorial serif, upper centre.
Scientific accuracy: fingertip skin wrinkles after about fifteen minutes in water, driven by the nervous system narrowing fingertip blood vessels; an illustration, not a photograph.
Avoid: no faces, arrows, circles, logos, watermarks, brand names, extra text, or anything that looks like a real medical photo.
Style: premium medical-editorial documentary illustration, distinctive and art-directed, not generic AI art.
